mapper.select: SELECT nvl(t1.plannedDueAmount, 0) plannedDueAmount, to_date(t2.datevalue,'YYYY-MM-DD') plannedDueDate FROM ( SELECT SUM(LCR.PLANNED_DUE_AMOUNT) plannedDueAmount, LCR.PLANNED_DUE_DATE plannedDueDate FROM LON_CONTRACT_REPAYMENT LCR JOIN LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW LCW ON LCR.WITHDRAW_ID=LCW.WITHDRAW_ID WHERE YEAR(LCR.PLANNED_DUE_DATE)= #{year} AND MONTH(LCR.PLANNED_DUE_DATE)= #{month} AND LCW.WITHDRAW_STATUS='APPROVED' AND LCW.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND LCW.COMPANY_ID=#{request.companyId} GROUP BY LCR.PLANNED_DUE_DATE) t1, ( SELECT #{year} || '-' ||#{month} || '-' || lpad(level, 2, 0) datevalue FROM dual CONNECT BY level < ( SELECT to_number(SUBSTR(last_day(to_date( #{year} || '-' || #{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')), 0, 2)) FROM dual) + 1) t2 WHERE t1.plannedDueDate(+) = t2.datevalue ORDER BY t2.datevalue

SELECT lcw.withdraw_number, lc.contract_number, lc.contract_name, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_id, lcr.due_date, lcr.planned_due_date, lcr.planned_calc_date, lcr.planned_due_amount, lcr.write_off_amount, wm_concat(DISTINCT hci.description) description FROM lon_contract_repayment lcr, lon_contract lc, hls_bp_master hbm, hls_cashflow_item hci, lon_contract_withdraw lcw
lcr.contract_id = lc.contract_id AND hbm.bp_id = lc.credit_bp_id AND hci.cf_item = lcr.cf_item and lcw.contract_id = lc.contract_id and lcr.withdraw_id = lcw.withdraw_id and lcr.write_off_flag = 'NOT' and lcw.data_class='NORMAL'
AND (hbm.bp_code LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{queryObject}),'%') OR hbm.bp_name LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{queryObject}),'%'))
AND (lcw.withdraw_number LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{queryMessage}),'%') or lc.contract_name LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{queryMessage}),'%'))
GROUP BY lcw.withdraw_number, lc.contract_number, lc.contract_name, hbm.bp_name

select lc.contract_id, lc.contract_number, lc.contract_name, lc.currency, (select fc.currency_name from fnd_currency fc where fc.currency_code = lc.currency) currency_name, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM
scv WHERE scv.code_value = lcr.write_off_flag AND scv.code = 'LON.WRITE_OFF_FLAG' ) write_off_flag_desc, lcw.withdraw_id, lcw.withdraw_number, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = lc.credit_bp_id) bp_name, lcr.cf_item, (select hci.description from hls_cashflow_item hci where hci.cf_type = 70 and hci.cf_item = lcr.cf_item) cf_item_desc, lcr.planned_due_date, lcr.planned_calc_date, lcr.planned_due_amount, (lcr.planned_due_amount*nvl(lcr.exchange_rate,1)) cny_planned_due_amount, lcr.due_date, lcr.write_off_amount from lon_contract_repayment lcr, lon_contract_withdraw lcw, lon_contract lc
lcr.withdraw_id = lcw.withdraw_id and lcw.contract_id = lc.contract_id and lcw.data_class='NORMAL' and lcw.company_id=#{request.companyId}
and nvl(lcr.confirm_flag,'N') = #{confirmFlag}
AND lc.credit_bp_id IN ( SELECT hbm.bp_id FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE 1=1 AND (hbm.bp_code LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{queryObject}),'%') OR hbm.bp_name LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{queryObject}),'%')))
AND (lcw.withdraw_number LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{queryMessage}),'%') or lc.contract_name LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{queryMessage}),'%'))
and ((nvl(lcr.confirm_flag,'N') = 'N' and lcr.planned_due_date >= to_date(#{queryDateFrom},'YYYY-MM-DD')) or (nvl(lcr.confirm_flag,'N') = 'Y' and lcr.due_date >= to_date(#{queryDateFrom},'YYYY-MM-DD')))
and ((nvl(lcr.confirm_flag,'N') = 'N' and lcr.planned_due_date <= to_date(#{queryDateTo},'YYYY-MM-DD')) or (nvl(lcr.confirm_flag,'N') = 'Y' and lcr.due_date <= to_date(#{queryDateTo},'YYYY-MM-DD')))
and ((YEAR( lcr.planned_due_date)= #{year} and MONTH( lcr.planned_due_date)= #{month}) or (YEAR( lcr.due_date)= #{year} and MONTH( lcr.due_date)= #{month}) )
AND MONTH(LCR.PLANNED_DUE_DATE)= #{month}
order by ( case when lcr.write_off_flag = 'NOT'then 1 when lcr.write_off_flag = 'PARTIAL' then 2 when lcr.write_off_flag = 'FULL' then 3 else 4 end), lcr.cf_item, lcr.planned_due_date DESC

SELECT lcw.withdraw_number, lc.contract_number, lc.contract_name, lc.major_contract_number, hbm.bp_id, hbm.bp_name, hci.description cf_item_desc, lcr.times, lcr.PLANNED_DUE_DATE, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM
scv WHERE scv.code_value = lcr.write_off_flag AND scv.code = 'LON.WRITE_OFF_FLAG' ) write_off_flag_desc, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM
scv WHERE scv.code_value = hbm.org_type AND scv.code = 'CSH.BANK_ORG_TYPE' ) org_type_desc, (select fc.company_short_name from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id = lc.lon_company_id) lon_company_id_desc, nvl(lcw.due_amount,0) withdraw_due_amount, lc.currency, (select fc.currency_name from fnd_currency fc where fc.currency_code = lc.currency) currency_name, lcr.planned_due_amount, lcr.write_off_amount, lcr.confirm_flag, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM
scv WHERE scv.code_value = lcr.confirm_flag AND scv.code = 'SYS.YES_NO' ) confirm_flag_desc FROM lon_contract_repayment lcr, lon_contract lc, hls_bp_master hbm, hls_cashflow_item hci, lon_contract_withdraw lcw
lcr.withdraw_id = lcw.withdraw_id and lcw.contract_id = lc.contract_id AND hbm.bp_id = lc.credit_bp_id AND hci.cf_item = lcr.cf_item and lcw.cf_item in (60) and lc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and lcw.data_class='NORMAL' and lcw.company_id=#{request.companyId} and lcw.WITHDRAW_STATUS = 'APPROVED'
AND hbm.org_type in
#{item}
AND lcw.due_amount >=#{amtFrom}
AND lcw.due_amount <=#{amtTo}
AND lc.contract_name LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{contractName}),'%')
AND lc.contract_number LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%')
AND hbm.bp_name LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{bpName}),'%')
AND lcw.withdraw_number LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{withdrawNumber}),'%')
AND lc.major_contract_number LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{majorContractNumber}),'%')
AND lc.currency in
#{item}
AND lcr.write_off_flag in
#{item}
and exists (select 1 from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id = lc.lon_company_id and fc.company_full_name LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{lonCompanyIdDesc}),'%'))
AND lcr.planned_due_date >= #{queryDateFrom}
AND #{queryDateTo} >=lcr.planned_due_date
ORDER BY lc.contract_number,lcw.due_date,lcr.planned_due_date

select frrl.flt_req_ln_id, lcr.times, lcr.planned_due_date due_date, lcr.planned_due_amount due_amount, 0.0 as principal, (select hci.description from hls_cashflow_item hci where hci.cf_type = 70 and hci.cf_item = lcr.cf_item) cf_item_desc, (select lcrt.planned_due_amount from lon_contract_repayment lcrt where lcrt.withdraw_id = frrl.change_req_id and lcrt.times = lcr.times and lcrt.cf_item = lcr.cf_item and lcrt.planned_due_date = lcr.planned_due_date) new_due_amount, 0.0 as new_principal from con_floating_rate_req_ln frrl, con_floating_rate_req frr, lon_contract_repayment lcr where frrl.flt_req_id = frr.flt_req_id and frrl.contract_id = lcr.withdraw_id and frr.document_type = 'LON_CONTRACT' and lcr.cf_item in (302) and frrl.flt_req_ln_id = #{fltReqLnId} UNION select frrl.flt_req_ln_id, ccc.times, ccc.due_date, ccc.interest due_amount, ccc.due_amount as principal, (select hci.description from hls_cashflow_item hci where hci.cf_type = 1 and hci.cf_item = ccc.cf_item) cf_item_desc, (select ccct.interest from con_contract_cashflow ccct where ccct.contract_id = frrl.change_req_id and ccct.times = ccc.times and ccct.cf_item = ccc.cf_item and ccct.due_date = ccc.due_date) new_due_amount, (select ccct.due_amount from con_contract_cashflow ccct where ccct.contract_id = frrl.change_req_id and ccct.times = ccc.times and ccct.cf_item = ccc.cf_item and ccct.due_date = ccc.due_date) new_principal from con_floating_rate_req_ln frrl, con_floating_rate_req frr, con_contract_cashflow ccc where frrl.flt_req_id = frr.flt_req_id and frrl.contract_id = ccc.contract_id and frr.document_type = 'CON_CONTRACT' and ccc.cf_item in (1) and frrl.flt_req_ln_id = #{fltReqLnId}

select * from (SELECT t1.withdraw_id, t1.withdraw_number, t1.lon_company_id, t1.company_short_name, t1.bp_name, t1.purpose_list, t1.begin_end_date, t1.financing_amount, -- CONVERT(t1.financing_amount,DECIMAL(16,4)) financing_amount, t1.withdraw_date, t1.repayment_date, max(t1.financing_balance) as financing_balance, sum(t1.interest_period_days) as interest_period_days, max(t1.int_rate) as int_rate, sum(nvl(t1.repayment_finance,0)) as repayment_finance, sum(nvl(t1.repayment_interest,0)) as repayment_interest, sum(nvl(t1.repayment_service_charge,0)) as repayment_service_charge, sum(nvl(t1.repayment_consult,0)) as repayment_consult, sum(nvl(t1.repayment_guarantee,0)) as repayment_guarantee, sum(nvl(t1.repayment_underwrite,0)) as repayment_underwrite, sum(nvl(t1.repayment_trustee,0)) as repayment_trustee, sum(nvl(t1.repayment_management,0)) as repayment_management, sum(nvl(t1.repayment_other,0)) as repayment_other, sum( nvl(t1.repayment_finance,0)+ nvl(t1.repayment_interest,0)+ nvl(t1.repayment_service_charge,0)+ nvl(t1.repayment_consult,0)+ nvl(t1.repayment_guarantee,0)+ nvl(t1.repayment_underwrite,0)+ nvl(t1.repayment_trustee,0)+ nvl(t1.repayment_management,0)+ nvl(t1.repayment_other,0) ) as repayment_total FROM ( SELECT lcr.withdraw_id, lcw.withdraw_number, lc.lon_company_id, ( SELECT fc.company_short_name FROM fnd_company fc WHERE fc.company_id = lc.lon_company_id ) AS company_short_name, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = lc.credit_bp_id ) AS bp_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( lcp_v.purpose_name ) FROM ( SELECT cc.contract_name AS purpose_name, lcp.withdraw_id FROM lon_contract_purpose lcp, con_contract cc WHERE lcp.purpose_doc_category = 'CON_CONTRACT' AND lcp.purpose_doc_id = cc.contract_id UNION SELECT fc.contract_name AS purpose_name, lcp.withdraw_id FROM lon_contract_purpose lcp, fct_contract fc WHERE lcp.purpose_doc_category = 'FCT_CONTRACT' AND lcp.purpose_doc_id = fc.contract_id UNION SELECT lcop.project_name AS purpose_name, lcop.withdraw_id FROM ct_lon_contract_other_purpose lcop ) lcp_v WHERE lcp_v.withdraw_id = lcw.withdraw_id ) AS purpose_list, concat( lcw.due_date, '/', lcw.withdraw_end_date ) AS begin_end_date, lcw.due_amount AS financing_amount, lcw.due_date AS withdraw_date, lcr.planned_due_date AS repayment_date, ( lcw.due_amount - ( SELECT sum(nvl(r.due_amount,0)) FROM lon_contract_repayment r WHERE r.cf_item = 301 AND r.withdraw_id = lcr.withdraw_id ) ) AS financing_balance, nvl( lcr.interest_period_days, 0 ) AS interest_period_days, lcw.int_rate, ( SELECT r.planned_due_amount FROM lon_contract_repayment r WHERE r.repayment_id = lcr.repayment_id AND r.cf_item = 301 ) AS repayment_finance, ( SELECT r.planned_due_amount FROM lon_contract_repayment r WHERE r.repayment_id = lcr.repayment_id AND r.cf_item = 302 ) AS repayment_interest, ( SELECT r.planned_due_amount FROM lon_contract_repayment r WHERE r.repayment_id = lcr.repayment_id AND r.cf_item = 303 ) AS repayment_service_charge, ( SELECT r.planned_due_amount FROM lon_contract_repayment r WHERE r.repayment_id = lcr.repayment_id AND r.cf_item = 304 ) AS repayment_consult, ( SELECT r.planned_due_amount FROM lon_contract_repayment r WHERE r.repayment_id = lcr.repayment_id AND r.cf_item = 305 ) AS repayment_guarantee, ( SELECT r.planned_due_amount FROM lon_contract_repayment r WHERE r.repayment_id = lcr.repayment_id AND r.cf_item = 306 ) AS repayment_underwrite, ( SELECT r.planned_due_amount FROM lon_contract_repayment r WHERE r.repayment_id = lcr.repayment_id AND r.cf_item = 307 ) AS repayment_trustee, ( SELECT r.planned_due_amount FROM lon_contract_repayment r WHERE r.repayment_id = lcr.repayment_id AND r.cf_item = 308 ) AS repayment_management, ( SELECT r.planned_due_amount FROM lon_contract_repayment r WHERE r.repayment_id = lcr.repayment_id AND r.cf_item = 309 ) AS repayment_other FROM lon_contract lc, lon_contract_withdraw lcw, lon_contract_repayment lcr WHERE lcw.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND lcw.withdraw_status IN ( 'APPROVED', 'PENDING' ) AND lcw.contract_id = lc.contract_id AND lcw.withdraw_id = lcr.withdraw_id AND (lcr.write_off_flag != 'FULL' or lcr.write_off_flag is null) ) t1 group by t1.withdraw_id,t1.repayment_date) t2
1=1
and t2.lon_company_id in
#{item}
and t2.bp_name like concat('%',#{bpName},'%')
and to_days(t2.withdraw_date) > to_days(#{withdrawDateFrom})
and to_days(#{withdrawDateTo}) > to_days(t2.withdraw_date)
and to_days(t2.repayment_date) > to_days(#{repaymentDateFrom})
and to_days(#{repaymentDateTo}) > to_days(t2.repayment_date)
and t2.repayment_total > #{repaymentTotalFrom}
and #{repaymentTotalTo} > t2.repayment_total
and t2.withdraw_number like concat('%',#{withdrawNumber},'%')

select nvl(sum(lcr.planned_due_amount),0) from lon_contract_repayment lcr where lcr.withdraw_id=#{withdrawId}
and ((#{interestFlag} = 'Y' and lcr.cf_item in (301)) or (#{interestFlag} = 'N' and lcr.cf_item not in (301,302)))
select lcr.* from lon_contract_repayment lcr where lcr.withdraw_id = #{withdrawId} and lcr.cf_item = '302' order by lcr.planned_due_date
select nvl(sum(t.PLANNED_DUE_AMOUNT),0) as sumAmount from lon_contract_repayment t where t.cf_item=301 and t.WITHDRAW_ID=#{withdrawId} and #{incomeDate}>planned_due_date
select max(times) from lon_contract_repayment lcr where lcr.cf_item=302 and lcr.withdraw_id=#{withdrawId}
select sum(lcr.planned_due_amount) from lon_contract_repayment lcr where lcr.cf_item=302 and lcr.withdraw_id=#{withdrawId}
SELECT count( DISTINCT amortization_method ) FROM lon_contract_repayment WHERE withdraw_id = #{withdrawId} and cf_item = #{cfItem}
